'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**The [[Israeli military]] (IDF) carries out several [[airstrike]]s in the [[Gaza Strip]], in response to overnight rocket attacks in Israel. IDF says it targeted a rocket manufacturing site, underground infrastructure and a military post. Two minor injuries are reported. The attacks caused [[power outage]]s in the eastern part of the strip. Hamas claims the strikes damaged a children's hospital, a centre for disabled people, and damaged the windows of several residential buildings. IDF claims that the damage was due to detonations of ground munitions. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/26/israeli-air-attacks-gaza-injuries (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/hamas-israeli-strike-damaged-gaza-childrens-hospital-special-needs-center (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Kashmir conflict]] 
**[[India]] arrests 75 Kashmiri political leaders and activists for "preventive custody" due to recent violence following local elections. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/26/india-detains-75-in-kashmir-after-local-election (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents''' 
*Twelve climbers die during avalanches and blizzards on mountains north of [[Tehran]], [[Iran]]. Fourteen others went missing but are rescued alive. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/27/climbers-killed-in-avalanches-in-irans-alborz-mountains (''The Guardian'')]
*A fire inside an [[intensive care unit]] for [[COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt|COVID-19]] patients at a hospital in [[Obour (city)|Obour]], [[Egypt]], kills seven people and injures five others. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/fire-egyptian-hospital-kills-coronavirus-patients-74913827 (ABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
*****[[Spain]] receives its first shipment of the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[vaccine]] [[tozinameran]] in [[Guadalajara, Spain|Guadalajara]], a day before the country begins its vaccination programme. [https://www.euroweeklynews.com/2020/12/26/pfizers-vaccine-shipment-arrives-in-spain/ (Euro Weekly News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Community of Madrid]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Madrid]] reports the nation's first four cases of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/26/spain-and-sweden-report-cases-of-uk-covid-variant (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Northern Ireland]]
*****[[Northern Ireland]] enters a six-week [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] in an effort to reduce the number of [[COVID-19]] infections. All "non-essential" shops and businesses will be closed, while "essential" shops must close each day by 20:00 [[GMT]] during the first week of the lockdown. No gatherings will be allowed between 20:00 and 6:00 each day, and anyone travelling to Northern Ireland must self-isolate for at least 10 days. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-55425775 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]], [[2020 Belarusian protests]]
****Two men jailed for protesting against [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] say they tested positive for COVID-19, after developing symptoms in jail and not receiving treatment. [https://apnews.com/article/belarus-coronavirus-pandemic-only-on-ap-prisons-802ce0309de3df0df64d82d4deaa0ab9 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****The [[Germany|German]] state of [[Saxony-Anhalt]] begins a [[vaccination]] campaign against [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], which also began nationwide. A 101-year-old woman in a nursing home  become one of first people in the country to get vaccinated. [https://www.dw.com/en/coronavirus-101-year-old-woman-among-first-in-germany-to-receive-biontech-pfizer-covid-vaccine/a-56065181 (DW)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] begins a vaccination campaign against COVID-19 using the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine [[tozinameran]]. The first vaccinations are being delivered at two [[List of hospitals in Hungary|hospitals]] in [[Budapest]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-vaccines-hungary/hungary-starts-coronavirus-vaccinations-government-spokesman-idUKKBN29009N?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] surpasses three million cases of COVID-19, becoming the fourth country to do so after the [[United States]], [[India]], and [[Brazil]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1783091/world (''Arab News'')] [https://www.livemint.com/news/world/russia-tops-3-million-covid-19-infections-11608980062759.html (''Mint'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[Sweden]] reports their first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 after a traveller from the [[United Kingdom]] tested positive for COVID-19. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/531697-sweden-says-it-found-case-of-uk-coronavirus-variant-in-uk (''The Hill'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
*****[[Ontario]] reports its first two cases of a new SARS-COV-2 variant in a couple from [[Regional Municipality of Durham|Durham Region]] with no known travel history, exposure, or high-risk contacts. Ontario is the first province in Canada to identify a case of this new variant. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/ontario-confirms-first-cases-covid19-uk-variant-1.5855361 (CBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] issues guidelines stating that people with underlying health conditions can receive the [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/531722-cdc-issues-new-guidance-about-vaccinations-for-people-with-underlying (''The Hill'')]
****One out of every 1,000 Americans have died from COVID-19, according to a comparison of census and death toll estimates. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/26/us/1-in-1000-died-coronavirus-timeline/index.html (CNN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Tokyo]] reports a record 949 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed cases in the prefecture to 55,851. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/12/26/national/tokyo-record-949-coronavirus-japan/ (''The Japan Times'')]
****The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Japan)|Japanese Foreign Ministry]] will ban non-resident foreign nationals from entering [[Japan]] from December 28 until the end of January after several cases of [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|a more infectious variant of SARS-CoV-2]] were reported in the country. Japanese citizens and foreign residents will be required to self-quarantine for 14 days when they enter the country. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/26/asia/japan-ban-foreign-nationals-intl/index.html (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 6,389 recoveries in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of recoveries to 576,693. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5310296/pecah-rekor-lagi-26-desember-ada-6389-pasien-covid-19-sembuh (detikNews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] extends a nighttime traffic [[curfew]] that runs from 9:00 p.m. to 4:00 a.m. local time to 330 lower-risk "yellow" cities in an effort to sustain a recent decrease in the numbers of new cases and deaths. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/iran-extends-traffic-curfew-to-330-cities-to-sustain-virus-decline/story-ETfZgLEEiR4W1RgtMVhVuM.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 2,335 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 103,900. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/malaysia-records-new-daily-high-of-covid-19-cases-13845080 (CNA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 Nashville bombing]]
**Federal investigators identify a person of interest in yesterday's bombing in downtown [[Nashville, Tennessee]], and join local police in raiding his home. [https://apnews.com/article/us-news-nashville-coronavirus-pandemic-tennessee-dc6eb653053967a4187f0ca8276d20a8 (AP)]
**Authorities announce that they suspect the incident was a suicide bombing, following the discovery of human remains at the blast site. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/26/us/nashville-tn-explosion/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Breonna Taylor protests]], [[United States racial unrest (2020–2023)|2020 United States racial unrest]]
**A statue of [[Breonna Taylor]], a black woman [[Killing of Breonna Taylor|killed]] by police during a raid at her home in March 2020, has been smashed and destroyed during a racist assault. The statue was erected two weeks ago in [[Oakland]], [[California]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55474228 (BBC News)]
*[[Crime in Germany]]
**Four men are seriously injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Kreuzberg]], [[Berlin]]. The city's attorney said that rival gangs may have been responsible for the shooting. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55453060 (BBC News)]
*[[Crime in China]]
**[[China]] lowers the [[age of criminal responsibility]] to 12 years old for "abominable" crimes such as [[murder]] or causing injury that leads to death or severe disabilities by extremely cruel means. The measure was passed by the [[National People's Congress Standing Committee]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2020/12/26/China-lowers-age-of-criminal-responsibility-for-abominable-crimes-to-12 (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**Three people are killed, and three others are injured, during a [[mass shooting]] at a bowling alley in [[Rockford, Illinois]]. Police believe the suspect, in custody, identified as a [[United States Army|soldier]] from [[Florida]], randomly selected his victims. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/27/us-man-charged-in-illinois-bowling-alley-shooting-that-killed-3 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Ethiopian general election]]
**The [[government of Ethiopia|government]] sets June 5 as the date for the 2021 parliamentary elections. The elections were delayed to 2021 in response to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Ethiopia|COVID-19 pandemic]] with the delay being a cause of the ongoing [[Tigray conflict]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/ethiopia-election-idUSKBN28Z0NN (Reuters)] 

'''Sports'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]], [[2020 NFL season]]
**The [[Cleveland Browns]] announce that they will close their facility and delay their flight to [[New Jersey]] for an upcoming matchup with the [[New York Jets]] after a player on the team tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-nfl-idUSKBN2900IA (Reuters)]
